messages:
morgan: Hey team — opened a PR that splits the tracehook metric + dashboard work and renames one metric. can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/12890

morgan: TL;DR: refactor + small migration script, dashboards updated with aliases. unit tests pass locally, CI hit a flaky e2e on integration-redis.

ci-bot: CI: build passed, e2e flaky (integration-redis). rerun available.

arpit: I can review the code now. pinging infra to rerun the flaky job.

lina: skimmed the changes — question: you renamed `console.trace.latency_ms` -> `trace.request_latency_ms`. will that break any historical dashboards?

morgan: good call. added a tiny migration script in the PR and left an alias in the dashboard so both metrics resolve for the next week. script is scripts/migrate_metric_names.sh (bash):

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# rename metric keys in TSDB backup for a short migration window
set -e
python tools/tsdb_migrate.py --from "console.trace.latency_ms" --to "trace.request_latency_ms"
```

jess: leaving a comment on the PR about making the alias window configurable. ops asked for 30 days instead of 7.

sam: +1 on 30 days, otherwise LGTM pending CI. I'll approve after green.

arpit: quick code nit: debounce in the tracehook frontend is 300ms — I suggested 200ms in a PR comment (UX smoother). not blocking.

morgan: thanks — applied arpit's frontend suggestion in a follow-up commit.

morgan: plan: need one more approval + green CI and I can merge this evening. anyone able to run the e2e rerun?

jess: running it now: `/ci rerun 12890` — queued. will post status.

ci-bot: Build #12890 rerun queued by jess — status: pending.

morgan: also posted a preview of the updated dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/preview/tracehook-12890

lina: preview looks good to me :thumbsup: no obvious gaps in the panels.

morgan: thanks all — will merge once rerun is green and we have one more approval. appreciate the quick turn!
